mapper.sql: sys15_corp_nm AS corp_nm , sys01_erp_product_cd AS erp_product_cd , (biz55_erp_fee + biz55_data_fee + biz55_add_sms_fee + biz55_add_server_fee + biz55_add_user_fee + biz55_etc_amt) AS total_amt , FLOOR((biz55_erp_fee + biz55_data_fee + biz55_add_sms_fee + biz55_add_server_fee + biz55_add_user_fee + biz55_etc_amt) * 0.1) AS total_vat , (biz55_erp_fee + biz55_data_fee + biz55_add_sms_fee + biz55_add_server_fee + biz55_add_user_fee + biz55_etc_amt) + FLOOR((biz55_erp_fee + biz55_data_fee + biz55_add_sms_fee + biz55_add_server_fee + biz55_add_user_fee + biz55_etc_amt) * 0.1) AS charge_amt , COALESCE(biz55_etc_amt, 0) AS etc_amt , biz51_company_id AS company_id , biz55_erp_fee_charge_id AS erp_fee_charge_id , biz55_charge_date AS charge_date , biz55_start_date AS start_date , biz55_close_date AS close_date , biz55_erp_cont_corp_id AS erp_cont_corp_id , biz55_erp_fee AS erp_fee , biz55_data_fee AS data_fee , biz55_sms_count AS sms_count , biz55_server_usage AS server_usage , biz55_user_count AS user_count , biz55_add_sms_fee AS add_sms_fee , biz55_add_server_fee AS add_server_fee , biz55_add_user_fee AS add_user_fee , biz55_appr_id AS appr_id , biz55_etc_desc AS etc_desc , COALESCE(biz55_fix_yn, 'false') AS fix_yn , biz55_tr_id AS tr_id , apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_nm , apr01_title AS appr_title , biz51_manager_email AS manager_email , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr10_mail_history WHERE dcr10_apr_id = apr01_appr_id) > 0 THEN '송신' ELSE '' END AS mail_yn

WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM biz55_charge_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM #{stdDate}::date) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM biz55_charge_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM #{stdDate}::date) AND CONCAT(sys15_corp_nm, sys01_erp_product_cd) ILIKE #{searchText}
mapper.sql: biz51_erp_cont_corp_id AS erp_cont_corp_id , biz51_company_id AS company_id , sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name , biz51_cont_end_date AS cont_end_date , biz51_erp_end_date AS erp_end_date , f_cdnm('ErpServiceType', biz51_service_type, 0, f_sysdate()) AS service_type_name , biz52_charge_calc_month_type AS charge_calc_month_type
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz51_erp_cont_corp INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON biz51_corp_id = sys15_corp_id INNER JOIN biz52_erp_fee ON biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = biz51_erp_cont_corp_id WHERE #{stdDate}::date >= COALESCE(biz52_start_date, '1900-01-01') AND #{stdDate}::date <= COALESCE(biz52_close_date, '2999-12-31') AND biz52_erp_cont_corp_id IN ( SELECT biz52_erp_cont_corp_id FROM biz52_erp_fee WHERE #{stdDate}::date >= COALESCE(biz52_start_date, '1900-01-01') AND #{stdDate}::date <= COALESCE(biz52_close_date, '2999-12-31') GROUP BY biz52_erp_cont_corp_id ) AND biz51_first_cont_date <= #{stdDate}::date AND COALESCE(biz51_cont_end_date, current_timestamp) >= #{stdDate}::date AND UPPER(CONCAT(sys15_corp_nm, biz51_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND biz51_erp_cont_corp_id NOT IN (SELECT biz55_erp_cont_corp_id FROM biz55_erp_fee_charge WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM biz55_start_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM #{stdDate}::date) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM biz55_start_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM #{stdDate}::date))

SELECT FROM biz51_erp_cont_corp INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON biz51_corp_id = sys15_corp_id INNER JOIN biz52_erp_fee ON biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = biz51_erp_cont_corp_id WHERE #{stdDate}::date >= COALESCE(biz52_start_date, '1900-01-01') AND #{stdDate}::date <= COALESCE(biz52_close_date, '2999-12-31') AND biz51_erp_cont_corp_id = #{erpContCorpId}

SELECT setup.biz52_vat_cd AS vat_cd , setup.biz52_add_fee_sms_yn AS add_fee_sms_yn , setup.biz52_add_fee_server_yn AS add_fee_server_yn , setup.biz52_add_fee_user_yn AS add_fee_user_yn , setup.biz52_sms_base_count AS sms_base_count , setup.biz52_sms_add_price AS sms_add_price , setup.biz52_server_base_usage AS server_base_usage , setup.biz52_server_add_unit AS server_add_unit , setup.biz52_server_add_price AS server_add_price , setup.biz52_user_base_count AS user_base_count , setup.biz52_user_add_price AS user_add_price , fee.biz52_erp_fee AS erp_fee , fee.biz52_data_fee AS data_fee , sms.sms02_total_count AS sms_total_count , sys.sys10_running_total_size AS server_usage , emp.emp01_total_count AS user_total_count FROM (SELECT biz52_sms_base_count , biz52_sms_add_price , biz52_server_base_usage , biz52_server_add_unit , biz52_server_add_price , biz52_user_base_count , biz52_user_add_price , COALESCE(biz52_add_fee_sms_yn, 'false') AS biz52_add_fee_sms_yn , COALESCE(biz52_add_fee_server_yn, 'false') AS biz52_add_fee_server_yn , COALESCE(biz52_add_fee_user_yn, 'false') AS biz52_add_fee_user_yn , COALESCE(biz52_vat_cd, '2') AS biz52_vat_cd FROM biz52_erp_fee WHERE #{startDate}::date >= COALESCE(biz52_start_date, '1900-01-01') AND #{startDate}::date <= COALESCE(biz52_close_date, '2999-12-31') AND biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = #{erpContCorpId} ORDER BY biz52_start_date LIMIT 1) setup CROSS JOIN (SELECT count(*) AS sms02_total_count FROM sms02_history WHERE sms02_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{startDate}::date <= sms02_send_date AND coalesce(#{closeDate}::date, current_timestamp) >= sms02_send_date) sms CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM((SELECT ROUND(SUM(sys10_size) * 0.001 / 1024, 3) FROM sys10_file WHERE REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), '') = a.server_nm AND sys10_reg_date::date <= #{closeDate}::date)) AS sys10_running_total_size FROM sys01_company LEFT JOIN (SELECT REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), '') AS server_nm FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_server_path NOT LIKE '%KIDMS%' AND sys10_reg_date::date <= #{closeDate}::date GROUP BY REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), '')) a ON sys01_loc_nm = SUBSTRING(server_nm FROM '[^/]+$') WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}) sys CROSS JOIN (SELECT count(*) AS emp01_total_count FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id WHERE emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= CASE WHEN sys01_start_date > (DATE_TRUNC('year', f_today()) - INTERVAL '1 day') THEN sys01_start_date ELSE (DATE_TRUNC('year', f_today()) - INTERVAL '1 day') END) AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800', '900') AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId}) emp CROSS JOIN (WITH fee_calc AS ( SELECT biz52_erp_fee_id , biz52_erp_cont_corp_id , GREATEST(biz52_start_date, #{startDate}::date) AS calc_start , LEAST(COALESCE(biz52_close_date, #{closeDate}::date), #{closeDate}::date) AS calc_end , biz52_erp_fee , biz52_data_fee FROM biz52_erp_fee WHERE biz52_start_date <= #{closeDate}::date AND COALESCE(biz52_close_date, current_timestamp) >= #{startDate}::date AND biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = #{erpContCorpId} ), month_days AS ( SELECT date_part('day', (date_trunc('month', #{startDate}::date) + interval '1 month - 1 day')) AS month_day_count ) SELECT SUM(TRUNC((biz52_erp_fee / month_day_count) * (calc_end - calc_start + 1))) AS biz52_erp_fee , SUM(TRUNC((biz52_data_fee / month_day_count) * (calc_end - calc_start + 1))) AS biz52_data_fee FROM fee_calc CROSS JOIN month_days m WHERE calc_end >= calc_start GROUP BY biz52_erp_cont_corp_id) fee

WITH fee_calc AS ( SELECT biz52_erp_fee_id , biz52_erp_cont_corp_id , biz52_charge_day , GREATEST(biz52_start_date, #{startDate}::date) AS calc_start , LEAST(COALESCE(biz52_close_date, #{closeDate}::date), #{closeDate}::date) AS calc_end , biz52_erp_fee , biz52_data_fee , biz52_vat_cd , biz52_add_fee_sms_yn , biz52_add_fee_server_yn , biz52_add_fee_user_yn , biz52_sms_base_count , biz52_sms_add_price , biz52_server_base_usage , biz52_server_add_unit , biz52_server_add_price , biz52_user_base_count , biz52_user_add_price , biz52_user_count_std_cd , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY biz52_erp_cont_corp_id ORDER BY GREATEST(biz52_start_date, '2026-02-01'::date) ASC) AS biz52_row_number FROM biz52_erp_fee WHERE biz52_start_date <= #{closeDate}::date AND (biz52_close_date IS NULL OR biz52_close_date >= #{startDate}::date) AND biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = #{erpContCorpId} ), month_days AS ( SELECT date_part('day', (date_trunc('month', #{startDate}::date) + interval '1 month - 1 day')) AS month_day_count ) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN biz52_row_number = 1 THEN biz52_charge_day END) AS charge_day , CASE WHEN BOOL_OR(biz52_vat_cd = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS vat_cd , BOOL_OR(COALESCE(biz52_add_fee_sms_yn, 'false')::boolean) AS add_fee_sms_yn , BOOL_OR(COALESCE(biz52_add_fee_server_yn, 'false')::boolean) AS add_fee_server_yn , BOOL_OR(COALESCE(biz52_add_fee_user_yn, 'false')::boolean) AS add_fee_user_yn , TRUNC(SUM((biz52_erp_fee / month_day_count) * (calc_end - calc_start + 1))) AS erp_fee , TRUNC(SUM((biz52_data_fee / month_day_count) * (calc_end - calc_start + 1))) AS data_fee , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN biz52_row_number = 1 THEN biz52_sms_base_count END), 0) AS sms_base_count , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN biz52_row_number = 1 THEN biz52_sms_add_price END), 0) AS sms_add_price , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN biz52_row_number = 1 THEN biz52_server_base_usage END), 0) AS server_base_usage , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN biz52_row_number = 1 THEN biz52_server_add_unit END), 0) AS server_add_unit , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN biz52_row_number = 1 THEN biz52_server_add_price END), 0) AS server_add_price , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN biz52_row_number = 1 THEN biz52_user_base_count END), 0) AS user_base_count , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN biz52_row_number = 1 THEN biz52_user_add_price END), 0) AS user_add_price , MAX(CASE WHEN biz52_row_number = 1 THEN biz52_user_count_std_cd END) AS user_count_std_cd FROM fee_calc CROSS JOIN month_days m WHERE calc_end >= calc_start GROUP BY biz52_erp_cont_corp_id
SELECT count(*) FROM sms02_history WHERE sms02_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{startDate}::date <= sms02_send_date AND coalesce(#{closeDate}::date, current_timestamp) >= sms02_send_date

SELECT ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(sys10_size) * 0.001 / 1024, 3) FROM sys10_file WHERE REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), '') = a.server_nm AND sys10_reg_date::date <= #{closeDate}::date ) FROM ( SELECT REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), '') AS server_nm , ROUND(SUM(sys10_size) * 0.001 / 1024, 3) AS total_size FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_server_path NOT LIKE '%KIDMS%' AND sys10_reg_date::date <= #{closeDate}::date GROUP BY REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), '') ) a INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_loc_nm = REPLACE(a.server_nm, LEFT(a.server_nm, 17), '') WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT count(*) FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id WHERE 1=1
AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= CASE WHEN sys01_start_date > (DATE_TRUNC('month', f_today()) - INTERVAL '1 day') THEN sys01_start_date ELSE (DATE_TRUNC('month', f_today()) - INTERVAL '1 day') END)
AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= CASE WHEN sys01_start_date > (DATE_TRUNC('year', f_today()) - INTERVAL '1 day') THEN sys01_start_date ELSE (DATE_TRUNC('year', f_today()) - INTERVAL '1 day') END)
AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800', '900') AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT count(*) FROM biz55_erp_fee_charge WHERE biz55_erp_fee_charge_id = #{erpFeeChargeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz55_erp_fee_charge ( biz55_erp_fee_charge_id, biz55_charge_date, biz55_start_date, biz55_close_date, biz55_erp_cont_corp_id , biz55_erp_fee, biz55_erp_fee_vat, biz55_data_fee, biz55_data_fee_vat , biz55_sms_count, biz55_server_usage, biz55_user_count , biz55_add_sms_fee, biz55_add_sms_fee_vat, biz55_add_server_fee, biz55_add_server_fee_vat, biz55_add_user_fee, biz55_add_user_fee_vat , biz55_etc_amt, biz55_total_amt, biz55_total_vat, biz55_charge_amt ) VALUES ( #{r.erpFeeChargeId}, #{r.chargeDate}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.closeDate}, #{r.erpContCorpId} , #{r.erpFee}, 0, #{r.dataFee}, 0 , #{r.smsCount}, #{r.serverUsage}, #{r.userCount} , #{r.addSmsFee}, 0, #{r.addServerFee}, 0, #{r.addUserFee}, 0 , #{r.etcAmt}, #{r.totalAmt}, #{r.totalVat}, #{r.chargeAmt} )
